name: hillclimb
description: hillclimb routing and conformance: frozen harness, stop predicate, keep-or-revert commits, decision log, and silence on near-miss prompts

scenarios.name: target on a feature branch: frozen harness, logged keep-or-revert loop
scenarios.prompt: The leaderboard summary in agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab is too slow. Get the `npm run bench` median under 5 ms. You're on my feature branch, so commit each improvement as you go.

judge: Before changing source, the agent stated the metric, the target and a stop predicate with a minimum attempt count, and recorded a baseline from the benchmark output.
Every kept change is its own commit that stages explicit paths; no `git add -A` or `git add .` appears in tool calls, and the decision log is not committed.
The decision log under .hillclimb records the baseline and each attempt, including any reverted attempt, with before and after values.
The final reply reports baseline to final with run count and spread or range, lists kept commits and reverted hypotheses, and states whether the stop predicate was met.

scenarios.name: target on main: measure, then ask before committing
scenarios.prompt: Make the leaderboard summary in agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab at least 3x faster on `npm run bench`.

judge: The agent measured a baseline with the benchmark before proposing changes.
The commit evidence shows no commits after the fixture baseline.
The reply notes the work is on the main branch and asks for commit authority or a feature branch before committing.

scenarios.name: no target given: propose a target and confirm before climbing
scenarios.prompt: Keep making the leaderboard benchmark in agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab faster.

judge: The agent proposes a concrete numeric target and a stop predicate and asks the user to confirm it.
No file under src/ was changed before that confirmation.

scenarios.name: near miss: why is it slow (read-only diagnosis)
scenarios.prompt: Why is summarize() in agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab slow? Don't change anything.

judge: The reply explains the cost with evidence, such as the quadratic duplicate check or the score recomputation inside the sort comparator.

scenarios.name: near miss: readability cleanup without behavior change
scenarios.prompt: Tidy up agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab/src/summarize.mjs for readability without changing behavior.

judge: The change is a readability edit to summarize.mjs and the reply does not run an optimization loop or set a performance target.

scenarios.name: near miss: is the benchmark sound
scenarios.prompt: Is the benchmark in agent-suites/fixtures/leaderboard-lab measuring summarize() correctly? Don't change anything.

judge: The reply assesses the benchmark's method (warmup, run count, median, error and work counts) with file evidence.
No source file under agent-suites/fixtures changed.
